name: flaky-pay
title: payment endpoint fails twice, then works
expect: When POST /api/pay fails with a temporary error (HTTP 503) the app must retry with backoff (at least 3 attempts) and finish the purchase. The user must end on the text "Order confirmed".

name: lost-response
title: payment goes through but the answer never arrives
expect: When POST /api/pay is processed by the server but the response is lost, a retry or a second click must never create a second order. Use an idempotency key: the browser sends one key per purchase (header Idempotency-Key) and the server returns the same order for the same key. The user must see "Order confirmed" and the orders page must show exactly "Orders: 1".

name: pay-down
title: payment is down for good
expect: When POST /api/pay keeps failing, the app must show a clear message that contains the words "payment is unavailable", must keep the item in the cart (the cart still lists the Mug), and must never show "Order confirmed".

name: slow-cart
title: cart answers after 12 seconds
expect: When GET /api/cart is slow, the checkout page must never be blank. It must show a loading text ("Loading your cart") while it waits, and when the cart fails or times out it must show a message and a "Try again" button. When the cart arrives it must list the Mug.

name: html-error
title: product list answers with an HTML error page
expect: When GET /api/products answers 200 with an HTML error page instead of JSON (every time), the page must not be blank. It must show a readable error message (for example "Could not load the shop") and a "Reload" button that fetches the products again.
